saw_lines: Golf cart owners buy by model, then check reviews from other owners before they order a part.
So the trust has to show in the ad itself, because a cold buyer leaves before scrolling to reviews on the site.
Your site shows 315 reviews, yet 0 of 6 live ads carry any proof number. Put the 315 count on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.
